mechanism: Naproxen (NSAID) may increase mefloquine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while mefloquine's neuropsychiatric effects are potentiated by NSAID-related CNS effects and gastrointestinal toxicity risk is elevated.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for mefloquine toxicity (neuropsychiatric symptoms, QT prolongation) and GI adverse effects, consider alternative antimalarial or analgesic.
